text:
maria (support): grouping related tickets into one triage thread. pattern: streaming + fn/tool calls + structured outputs. customers want: partial-arg streaming for fn calls, stricter schema enforcement for function outputs, and reconnect/resume semantics for flaky mobile. making this consolidated to prioritize.
jamie (pm): paste ticket list + severity?
maria (support): tickets: #4988 (AcmeCorp, P0 — needs partial-arg streaming to reduce perceived latency), #4991 (Learnly, P2 — strict schema enforcement for grading), #4995 (FinSys, P1 — resumable streams for mobile auditors), #4996 (pilot partner, P3). Acme is pressing; sales says blocker for GA integration.
alex (eng): high-level engineering take: partial-arg streaming requires changes across the streaming framing layer, SDK surface (how to expose incremental args), and runtime batching. Risk areas: inter-request batching interference, KV cache boundaries, and tokenization boundaries across chunks. Rough timeline: small beta in ~6 weeks if scoped tightly, production-quality GA in 3-4 sprints.
li (solutions): customers provided an expected wire pattern (they prefer event frames):
```
event: fn_call.start
payload: {"name":"get_profile"}
event: fn_call.arg_chunk
payload: "{\"user_id\": 12"
event: fn_call.arg_chunk
payload: ", \"fields\": [\"email\"]}"
event: fn_call.end
```
They want each chunk to be valid UTF-8 and an explicit finalization frame with status (ok/partial/error). Also want client-side reassembly guidance and retry semantics documented.
todd (sales): Acme will commit if we provide an opt-in beta with an SLA for streaming delivery guarantees. They also want a recovery path when their mobile clients reconnect mid-arg.
jamie (pm): proposed launch criteria for any rollout:
- API contract doc + public beta spec approved by product/eng/security
- 2 pilot customers live (one high-volume customer for load validation)
- No >1% regressions on 99th-pctl latency for representative workloads
- SDKs (python/js) ship streaming fn_call helpers + examples
- Integration tests proving no KV/prefix cache corruption
- Clear rollback (header toggle to disable streaming per-request)
alex (eng): engineering blockers to highlight:
- framing: extend current SSE/stream framing to support typed event frames without breaking existing streaming consumers
- batching: ensure arg chunks cannot be interleaved across other requests in the same batch
- SDK surface: synchronous vs async reassembly APIs + backpressure
- observability: traces to link partial-arg frames to completed calls for debugging
I'll draft a tech spec and open issues.
dev-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/2078 7 streaming-partial-arg-fncall (labels: eng-runtime, api, beta)
maria (support): can we add customer acceptance criteria? e.g., reassembly max time, reconnect behavior for mid-arg, and what we do on partial parse errors. @li can you pull concrete examples from support tickets and include expected final JSON payloads?
li (solutions): will upload samples and transcripts to /shared/triage/streaming-samples by Wednesday. will include: expected final JSONs, edge-case fragments, and suggested SDK pseudo-code for reassembly.
jamie (pm): triage recommendation: move partial-arg streaming -> Backlog P1 (customer-blocker for Acme), strict structured-output enforcement -> Backlog P2 (important for Learnly), resumable/ idempotent streams -> Backlog P2 (dependent on platform replay capabilities). propose opt-in beta flag for early adopters.
todd (sales): +1. sales will coordinate with Acme legal for beta MSA addendum and draft SLA language.
alex (eng): I'll post a short eng-scope doc with estimates by EOW. PM please finalize beta acceptance checklist so we can size epics properly.
jamie (pm): will draft the public contract + beta checklist and loop in security for schema-validation constraints (limit regexes, avoid ReDoS, validate depth). also will add monitoring SLOs to console dashboards for pilot customers.
maria (support): thanks. I'll update the tickets with triage notes and message customers that we're scheduling an opt-in beta target. will ask for sample client logs for reconnect cases.
li (solutions): offering to build a small sample client lib showing reassembly and retry heuristics we can ship as a reference in SDKs.
jamie (pm): agree. next steps: eng spec + issues, samples from solutions/support, legal/SLA draft, and pilot invite list. meeting to sync next Tue 10am. :thumbsup:
